lessons: Back positive Asian Handicap (+1.5, +2.5) selections even with small model-to-breakeven deficits (<3%): positive handicap cushions went 7 of 7.
Do not veto Over 1.5 goals at 1.20–1.29 solely due to a LOSING framework record; Over 1.5 hit 18 of 22 times (81.8%) when vetoed. Use 'lower' instead.
Do not veto Double Chance '12' when missing player value exceeds 20%: heavy squad disruption produced decisive winners in 12 of 12 matches without a single draw.
Never apply Double Chance '12' lay-the-draw veto rules to 'Team or Draw' (1X/X2): 1X/X2 finished 3 of 3 and provides true draw protection.
Cease blanket vetoes on Double Chance '12' for LOSING framework records: 31 of 38 vetoed selections won; restrict vetoes to tightly priced domestic derbies without squad disparity.
Do not veto team Over 0.5 goals simply because model chance is slightly below break-even: 5 of 5 vetoed team Over 0.5 picks scored.
Exercise caution backing team Over 0.5 against dominant favorites or away sides: backed selections lost 3 of 7 times (Elfsborg, Mantova, Menemenspor).
Do not blanket veto 'Win to Nil — no' at <=1.24 on framework records: 4 of 5 selections won; only veto when the favorite's defense is intact and conceding negligible xG.
Do not treat Under 4.5 as an automatic safe cushion: Under 4.5 lost 2 of 5 matches despite short odds (1.22 and 1.25).
Back Under 3.5 in cup ties only when verified extreme squad rotation (e.g. missing value share >50%) suppresses offensive output.
football.summary: Replaced blanket vetoes on Over 1.5, DC '12', team Over 0.5, and 'Win to Nil — no' after they discarded dozens of winning bets, and reversed the missing-player rule on DC '12' because severe squad absences consistently produced decisive results rather than draws.

lessons: Veto 1st half totals when the identical matchup is documented in recent mistakes, regardless of an overall winning family record (saved 2 of 2 losses).
Back 1st half Unders when the total line is below 120.0 points at odds 1.90 or higher (won 10 of 11); avoid or reduce stake on Unders at 120.5 or higher (lost 4 of 6).
When the framework record for a betting family is LOSING, apply a downward adjustment to the model probability and back with lower confidence at odds of 1.90 or higher (won 4 of 4).
Do not back 1st half totals at odds below 1.90 unless the model probability exceeds 0.65 (won at 1.81 with 0.685 model probability; lost at 1.80 with 0.593).
Back NBA underdog handicaps (+1.5) with lower confidence when model probability exceeds 0.58, accepting odds between 1.70 and 1.85 (won 2 of 3).
nba.summary: Refined the sub-1.90 total odds rule to permit high-model exceptions, validated the LOSING framework probability adjustment, and added rules for fixture-specific vetoes, sub-120.0 Under totals, and short underdog handicaps.
